headline: Saint Louis loses the last match on the schedule
dek: Saint Louis beat Dayton, Davidson and Fordham in November and was the only A10 side to play again. Missouri State's win closed its ten-win season with five draws, five losses and nineteen goals conceded.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring did not settle the season: La Salle's 38 goals came with seven wins and eight defeats.

wire.line: Fordham is the only A10 side to have beaten Saint Louis, and Saint Louis won the next meeting between them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches have passed their date with no result, Saint Louis's visit to DePaul and Drexel's to Saint Joseph's, both in August; none is a score gap.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dayton's Cooper Lijewski has scored ten goals from 39 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Alex Smith has kept six shutouts for Saint Joseph's and conceded seventeen goals.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: VCU won twice all season, against three draws and ten defeats.

last_match.line: Saint Louis's first defeat since losing at Fordham in October.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
